scope: Read-only C, private arena layout and compact byte-format review; no execution or timing; wrapper guards are separately reviewed by benchmark_inventory
checks: Eight aligned disjoint regions checked using 64-bit extents before reads or writes
Reserved 128 KiB prefix exceeds the isolated build stack/data use; no caller input uses compiler stack
Output length and region checks bound the later 32-bit pointer arithmetic before any published output
NaN, infinities, negatives other than the supported -1 sentinel, nonintegers and out-of-range doubles are excluded before integer casts
Arbitrary Int32 scores retain stock first-occurrence dictionary order and exact signed value bits
Score cardinality >=65535 and non-smaller compact payloads fall back before writing the output region
MRF2 magic, row count, score count, version 2, Int32 dictionary, U32 offsets, U16 lengths and U16 keys match the stock layout
Row/unique bounds checked before content access; second pass consumes the same private copied inputs without callbacks
Global occupied-probe budget is at most 4*rows+slots, plus one empty-slot probe per row; exhaustion abandons private scratch without publishing output
recommendedBoundaries: 65534/65535 distinct scores with enough repeated rows to make compact otherwise beneficial
Each overlapping, unaligned or out-of-memory region
NaN, infinity, fractional and unsafe offsets/base; -1 versus other negative offsets
limits: Wrapper findings about inherited fixed base and input/native-memory aliasing belong to its separate review and need resolution before qualification

staticWasmLayout.method: Read-only binary section decoding, no instantiation or execution
